📊 Open-Jev: a score should come with its test version.

Our ledger now separates:
• historical public tasks
• independent JevBench versions
• pending 27B evaluation

Frozen evaluator + evidence 👇
https://zefan-cai.github.io/open-jev/benchmarks/

🚀 Open-Jev now has a fresh Linux install record.

📌 77 packages in an isolated venv
✅ CLI + CPU reference + sm90 compile checks

Code, weights and versions are pinned. GPU inference is a separate validation.

Quickstart 👇
https://github.com/Zefan-Cai/Open-Jev/blob/25b63e5e41dd0f79b46806e999aa124c51322989/docs/deployment.md

⚡ Open-Jev kernel: 2.63–2.75× faster on H200.

One final-row operator. Whole-model 2B gain: ~1–2%, with significance unproven.

✅ 336 parity checks
✅ Zero decision/threshold flips

27B fast-CUDA is next. Data 👇
https://github.com/Zefan-Cai/Open-Jev/blob/42e46481da6dd8191d6f510fc3680c70fd4f051d/reports/efficiency-20261002/h200-2b-summary.md

🧪 A 64-step Open-Jev-2B pilot:

Synthetic test: 65.6% → 77.3%
Controlled OOD: 64.8% → 74.2%

Public JevBench64: Choice/Noul stayed flat. Score MAE improved on 7 items.

Numeric/time failures remain. Full results 👇
https://github.com/Zefan-Cai/Open-Jev/blob/42e46481da6dd8191d6f510fc3680c70fd4f051d/docs/frontier-controls-v4.md

🏦 We tested Open-Jev-2B on natural BANKING77 requests.

Accuracy: 64.8%
BM25 baseline: 82.4%

Calibration-locked policy: 14 errors among 88 accepted cases. Human review stays essential.

Negative results count too. Data 👇
https://github.com/Zefan-Cai/Open-Jev/blob/42e46481da6dd8191d6f510fc3680c70fd4f051d/docs/support-routing.md

🛠️ Open-Jev support workflow: input → real model → review → CSV.

Browser smoke: 12 natural training utterances. Unresolved reviews stayed unresolved.

External human trials: 0. Try the local workflow 👇
https://github.com/Zefan-Cai/Open-Jev/blob/42e46481da6dd8191d6f510fc3680c70fd4f051d/docs/support-routing.md

🔎 Five real community reports helped shape our Open-Jev experiments.

Support routing, code checks, retrieval and file selection.

They describe TypeSafe Jev; they are not Open-Jev customer stories.

Exact quotes + sources 👇
https://github.com/Zefan-Cai/Open-Jev/blob/42e46481da6dd8191d6f510fc3680c70fd4f051d/docs/community-evidence.md
